capabilities: prefix tab labels with parent folder names
add more parent folders until labels are unique
extras: The README warns that the plugin patches the rendered tab-header DOM because Obsidian has no public API for tab labels, so Obsidian updates may break it. It has no settings.
problem: Obsidian shows only the filename on tabs, so multiple notes with identical names look the same in the tab bar.
summary: Tab-label disambiguator that prefixes filenames with parent folder names so tabs with the same title are distinguishable.
